composition_subtypes.role: select numbers in increasing order of largest proper divisor to minimize imperfection
sort numbers by their largest proper divisor

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy selection by sorting numbers by largest proper divisor yields minimal imperfection for each k.
payload.rationale: The solution reduces the problem to a greedy strategy: the optimal subset of size k consists of the k numbers with smallest largest proper divisor. Then it sorts these precomputed values to get the answer sequence.
